title: Eidolon Bootstrap System State V1
description: What this Host knows about its own authority. It carried workspace_state and, in an earlier revision, recovery_state; neither is a fact Bootstrap holds. workspace_state was a durable claim that the Data plane held a Workspace for this Host, which outlived a data reset and stranded the Host; whether that Workspace exists is answered by GET /api/local/v1/setup/readiness. recovery_state was dropped from the store two schema versions ago and only ever held one value.
